title: Ground Zero 2D Mirror Gate 3D Canon
core_statements: Ground Zero is the Mirror Gate between compressed negative 2D space and expressed positive 3D space.
Negative 2D space is relational and has no native metric time or distance.
Awareness, memory access, cyberspace, dreamscape, and internal sensory construction operate in negative 2D relation.
Dreams are fast because awareness accesses relations rather than traversing represented 3D distance.
Electricity is expressed 3D displacement/pressure; magnetism is electricity mirrored into compressed negative 2D space.
Particles are wave excitations or discrete measurement events, not fundamental objects.
Eyes physically focus light waves and map peak/trough relations into an internal compressed field.
Correlations come from shared wave structure plus local measurement and later back-mapping; no spooky action is required.
